Reasoning: This stage keeps the end-effector pose fixed while completing a real grasp of cube_1. The fixed Cartesian position is represented by freeze_position on panda_fingertip with the required 0.01 m tolerance. The fixed full orientation is represented by freeze_orientation on panda_fingertip with the required 0.05 rad tolerance. The grasp success requirement is represented with object_grasped, rather than close_gripper, because the stage explicitly requires stable contact/effort-consistent bilateral grasp feedback and says mere closure to joint value 0.0 is not sufficient. The API cannot explicitly encode separate left/right finger symmetry, individual joint-state monitoring, or bilateral finger effort thresholds; these are captured only at the grasp-success level by object_grasped.
